sections.description:
Transform Your Content Into a Visibility Powerhouse

Content Publicity revolutionizes how your audience engages with your best content. It is a social sharing and digital marketing tool that bridges the gap between your website and Google News-approved publications through strategic content promotion and viral marketing capabilities.

🚀 Why Digital Marketers Use Content Publicity:
– Social media marketing made effortless with clean, professional share buttons
– Revolutionary “Super Suggest” feature suggests your content to real news editors at Google News sites
– Floating share bar keeps sharing options always visible for maximum viral potential
– Content marketing amplification through editorial outreach and press coverage opportunities
– Built for content creators, marketers, and businesses serious about online PR and growth hacking

❤️ The Game-Changing “Super Suggest” Feature

What makes Content Publicity unique in the digital marketing space? Our exclusive Super Suggest feature allows your engaged readers to recommend your content directly to editors at Google News-approved publications. This creates unprecedented opportunities for:

✅ Press coverage and media mentions
✅ High-authority backlinks from news sites
✅ Massive SEO boost from editorial citations
✅ Viral content amplification through media syndication
✅ Brand credibility and thought leadership
✅ Organic traffic explosion from press coverage

📊 Comprehensive Social Media Marketing & Viral Sharing Features

Dual Sharing Systems for Maximum Viral Potential:
– In-Content Share Button: Professional black & white design optimized for conversion
– Floating Share Bar: Always-visible left-side sharing panel for persistent engagement opportunities

Social Media Marketing Platforms Supported:
– LinkedIn (perfect for B2B content marketing and professional viral sharing)
– X/Twitter (instant viral potential and trending topic participation)
– Facebook (broad audience reach and social proof amplification)
– Email sharing (personal recommendations and influencer outreach)

Advanced Digital Marketing Customization:
– Choose button styles (icon, text, or both) for optimal conversion
– Position controls (before/after content) for strategic placement
– Post type targeting (posts, pages, custom types) for content marketing campaigns
– Individual post exclusions for sensitive content
– Responsive mobile design for cross-platform viral sharing

🎯 Perfect For These Digital Marketing Professionals

Content Marketing Specialists & SEO Professionals
Drive viral content campaigns, earn high-quality backlinks, and boost search rankings through editorial mentions and press coverage.

Social Media Marketing Managers
Amplify reach across all platforms, create viral sharing opportunities, and build social proof through professional sharing tools.

Digital PR & Online Marketing Agencies
Provide clients with direct access to news editors, systematic content amplification, and measurable press coverage results.

Growth Hackers & Viral Marketing Experts
Transform engaged readers into content ambassadors, create systematic viral loops, and establish repeatable growth channels.

Business Leaders & Entrepreneurs
Build thought leadership, generate press coverage, and establish industry authority through strategic content promotion and media outreach.

🔧 Technical Excellence & User Experience

WordPress Digital Marketing Best Practices:
– Lightweight, optimized code for fast loading
– Mobile-responsive design for cross-device viral sharing
– Accessibility (WCAG) compliant for inclusive marketing
– No external dependencies for reliable performance
– Privacy-focused (no tracking) for GDPR compliance

Easy Setup & Content Marketing Management:
– One-click installation and setup
– Modern iOS-style toggle interface with premium UX
– Comprehensive settings control for advanced campaigns
– Shortcode support for custom placement in marketing funnels

🌟 Content Syndication & Attribution System

Beyond social media marketing, Content Publicity makes your content embeddable across the web with proper SEO attribution:

  • HTML embed code generation with automatic attribution and backlinks
  • Featured image inclusion (customizable sizes) for visual social media marketing

  • SEO-friendly backlinks to boost your original content rankings
  • Copy-to-clipboard functionality for streamlined content syndication

📈 Digital Marketing Results You Can Expect

Immediate Social Media Marketing Benefits:
– Increased social media engagement and viral sharing
– More email shares and personal recommendations
– Better user experience with professional sharing options
– Enhanced social proof and content credibility

Long-Term Content Marketing & SEO Growth:
– Editorial coverage through Super Suggest recommendations
– High-authority backlinks from Google News-approved publications
– Improved search engine rankings from press mentions
– Enhanced brand credibility and industry recognition
– Viral content amplification and systematic growth

🎁 Bonus: Sitetrail Newspass Integration

For digital marketers seeking comprehensive news distribution and content syndication, Content Publicity integrates seamlessly with Sitetrail Newspass – our premium service for direct publication across 100+ authoritative news sites including Google News outlets. While Super Suggest handles organic reader recommendations, Newspass provides systematic, professional content distribution for serious content marketing campaigns.

The Perfect Digital Marketing Combination:
– Content Publicity: Organic, reader-driven viral marketing recommendations

– Detailed FAQ section covering common content marketing use cases and digital marketing strategies

– Enhances existing SEO and social media marketing strategies

Transform your content marketing strategy today. Install Content Publicity and start building the media relationships, viral sharing opportunities, and systematic growth that drive real business results.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. From WordPress Admin:

    • Navigate to Plugins → Add New
    • Search for “Content Publicity”
    • Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

  2. Initial Setup:

    • Go to Content Publicity in your admin menu
    • Configure your social media marketing preferences
    • Choose post types and appearance settings
    • Enable Super Suggest feature (recommended for press coverage)
    • Save settings and start your viral marketing campaign!

Manual Installation

  1. Download and Upload:

    • Download the plugin ZIP file
    • Upload via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
    • Or extract to /wp-content/plugins/content-publicity/

  2. Activation:

    • Activate through the Plugins menu
    • Configure settings under Content Publicity

Quick Digital Marketing Configuration Guide

Essential Content Marketing Settings:
– ✅ Enable Share Button (for in-content viral sharing)
– ✅ Enable Super Suggest Feature (for editorial outreach and press coverage)
– ⚙️ Choose post types (posts, pages, custom types)
– 🎨 Select button style and position for optimal conversion
– 📱 Configure social media platforms for targeted marketing

Advanced Online PR Options:
– Enable Floating Share Bar for persistent viral sharing opportunities
– Customize embed code options for content syndication
– Set up post exclusions for sensitive content
– Configure appearance and positioning for marketing campaigns
sections.faq:
What makes the “Super Suggest” feature unique for content marketing?

Super Suggest is the only feature that directly connects your content with editors at Google News-approved publications. When your readers click Super Suggest, they’re recommending your content for potential editorial coverage, citation, or republication. This creates opportunities for high-authority backlinks and press coverage that traditional social media marketing tools simply can’t provide.

How does Super Suggest work for digital PR and media outreach?

When a reader finds your content valuable, they can click the red heart (❤️) “Super Suggest to Google News Sites” button. This sends your article URL to editors at Google News-approved publications for review. If your content aligns with their editorial standards and current coverage areas, they may feature it, cite it, or provide editorial commentary – all of which create valuable backlinks and media exposure for your content marketing efforts.

Will the social sharing buttons slow down my website?

No! Content Publicity is built for performance-focused digital marketing:
– Lightweight, optimized code
– No external dependencies or scripts
– Minimal CSS and JavaScript footprint
– Uses WordPress’s built-in Dashicons (already loaded)
– Mobile-optimized responsive design for cross-platform marketing

Can I customize the appearance for my marketing campaigns?

Absolutely! Content Publicity offers extensive customization for content marketing:
– Button styles: Icon only, text only, or icon + text
– Positioning: Before content, after content, or manual shortcode placement
– Post types: Choose exactly where sharing appears for targeted campaigns
– Social platforms: Enable/disable specific networks for focused marketing
– Floating bar: Optional always-visible sharing panel for maximum viral potential
– Exclusions: Hide sharing on specific posts/pages

Is this GDPR and privacy compliant for international marketing?

Yes, completely! Content Publicity for digital marketing:
– Doesn’t track users or collect personal data
– Doesn’t use cookies or external tracking scripts
– All sharing links go directly to social platforms
– No data is stored or transmitted to our servers
– Fully compliant with privacy regulations for global marketing campaigns

How is this different from other social media marketing plugins?

Traditional social sharing plugins only let users share to their own social networks.

Content Publicity goes further for comprehensive digital marketing:
– Super Suggest connects your content to professional news editors
– Creates opportunities for press coverage and editorial mentions
– Generates high-authority backlinks from Google News-approved publications
– Includes content syndication functionality with proper attribution
– Built specifically for content marketing, viral marketing, and online PR goals

Can I use both the button and floating bar for maximum viral potential?

Yes! Many digital marketers enable both for comprehensive coverage:
– In-content button: Catches readers at the end of articles for conversion
– Floating bar: Provides persistent sharing options while reading for viral amplification
– Mobile responsive: Floating bar automatically hides on mobile devices
– Customizable: Enable/disable either feature independently for campaign optimization

What types of content work best with Super Suggest for press coverage?

Super Suggest works particularly well with content marketing focused on:
– Industry insights and analysis for thought leadership
– Breaking news or timely commentary for trending topic participation
– Research findings and data studies for authoritative coverage
– Expert opinions and thought leadership for media quotes
– Trend analysis and predictions for forward-looking coverage
– How-to guides and educational content for helpful resource citations

However, any well-written, valuable content has potential for editorial interest and viral amplification!

Do I need technical skills for digital marketing setup?

Not at all! Content Publicity is designed for marketers of all technical levels:
– One-click installation from WordPress plugin directory
– Modern intuitive admin interface with iOS-style toggles and clear descriptions
– Automatic setup with sensible defaults for immediate marketing results
– No coding required for basic social media marketing functionality
– Shortcode option for advanced users who want custom campaign placement

How can I track the success of my content marketing and viral campaigns?

While Content Publicity doesn’t include tracking (for privacy), you can monitor digital marketing success through:
– Google Analytics: Monitor referral traffic from news publications and social media
– Search Console: Track new backlinks and press coverage mentions
– Google Alerts: Set up alerts for your brand/content mentions across the web
– Social media analytics: Monitor increased shares and viral engagement
– Direct outreach: News editors may contact you for quotes or follow-up content

Can I customize the Super Suggest messaging for my brand?

The Super Suggest feature uses optimized messaging that’s proven effective with editors for content marketing campaigns. However, the plugin is developer-friendly with hooks and filters for customization. The default messaging emphasizes editorial value and Google News credibility, which has been optimized for editor response rates and press coverage generation.
